summary: At the selected prayer completion, C enters pray.c:fix_worst_trouble(TROUBLE_REGION) and calls region_safety(); JavaScript stops at note_unported('region.c region_safety'). The source scans hero-occupied gas-cloud regions, teleports if multiple clouds or one non-expiring cloud remains, otherwise removes a single expiring cloud, emits the corresponding message, and clears one-turn blindness. The first mismatch is the map boundary after that source action; RNG already matches completely.

source.branch: region_danger() (1341-1362) scans regions containing the hero and returns true only for an INSIDE_GAS_CLOUD region when the hero is neither nonliving/breathless nor poison resistant. region_safety() (1368-1405) scans the same regions and retains the first expiring gas cloud. Multiple clouds or one non-expiring cloud trigger safe_teleds(); if danger remains, C sets magical-breathing timeout to d(4,4)+4 and reports ability to breathe. A single expiring cloud is removed and gets a dissipates message; with no eligible cloud, C reports that it has dissipated. Finally, one-turn blindness is cleared.
callers: pray.c:pleased (1139, 1145, 1151, 1156) calls fix_worst_trouble for prayer trouble; pray.c:fix_worst_trouble (417-420) dispatches TROUBLE_REGION to region_safety(). JavaScript follows cmd.js #pray -> pray.js:prayer_done -> pleased -> fix_worst_trouble; fix_worst_trouble currently records note_unported('region.c region_safety') at js/pray.js:1468.

region_danger() callers also include pray.c:in_trouble (218), do_wear.c:Amulet_on/Amulet_off (984, 1128), and timeout.c:region_dialogue/nh_timeout (562, 885). Their existing JS callers are pray.js:in_trouble, do_wear.js:Amulet_on/Amulet_off, and timeout.js:region_dialogue/nh_timeout; scripts/region.test.mjs source-pins the pure helper.
dependencies: safe_teleds() is called with its C result discarded and already exists in js/teleport.js; region_safety receives it from pray.js to avoid a region.js/teleport.js cycle.

remove_region() result is discarded and its JS implementation is in js/region.js. Visible removal needs the existing does_block, unblock_point, cansee, and newsym operations supplied by the prayer caller.
region_danger() return value controls the post-teleport magical-breathing branch and is included in this task as the same-file dependency.
set_itimeout(), d(), and make_blinded() already have JavaScript owners; no other C return-value dependency is introduced.
